segments.text: Here's a Chrome extension you didn't know you needed until right now. It adds country flags next to every Twitter, sorry, X username automatically. As you
scroll, it quietly pulls each account's public location through Twitter's GraphQL API, figures out the country, and drops a clean little flag emoji
right next to the handle. And yes, it even works with infinite scroll replies, quote tweets, your timeline,
